column3: tell the account of the infinite Lord's deeds
one who commits offences without restraint
wife, sons, home, cattle, wealth and kin
in the search for the Self
the Self residing in the Self by the Self
the Self whose refuge is the Self
seeing the weapons blazing towards them, they took up their own
worthy of worship by the Self
the knowledge of the Self here
not seeing the Lord of the Self
a friend to those who worship
having entered, having caused to enter
he is the performer of the horse sacrifices
they call the Self of the Self
such is his power, this son of Abhimanyu
to him who had thus spoken
account of the battle of Indra and Vritra
in the form of the senses
as if the refuge of the Unconquered
by a sign, by a hint
by the look, by the glance
not approving the smearing of leftovers
with blooming blue lotuses, lotuses, kahlara and kumuda flowers
with loud, pure, charming laughter that shows passion
was about to lift up (and took)
with gardens, groves and parks and lotus ponds of charm
wandering like mad, dumb and dull
with the force of anger withdrawn
stood in front with hands joined
for the freedom from all bonds of the far-striding Lord
of the nature of a festival
having lived, in comparison with that
this is the power of the Lord
I went thus far and saw
one who delights in the Self alone
endowed with energy, strength and power
of the sex organ and tongue
funeral, pertaining to the body after death
with face adorned with hair, wet with sweat
whose life was struck by the touch of hair
in the city of Anarta, is it well?
O gentle one, is your self well?
burning with the fire of the weapon
in the form of a tortoise
with a throat beautiful like a conch
on the hand and the staff
with the tip of the hand
with thighs, arms, shoulders, cheeks and limbs
in the ear, the people whispering
because of the fruit of action
by household rites I (cannot be pleased)
whose mind is stained by desire
those who assume any form at will
subject to time, action and qualities
Time, the Lord, without beginning or end
is known by divisions of time
by time, nature and so on
Time is beginningless, the original maker, imperishable
what of other idle talk of life
how much more the beloved of Adhokshaja (Krishna)
by an evil-minded one, the Self
removes the sin of an evil mind by knowledge of the Self
the ocean of the Kuru army, with no far shore
of the Kuru dynasty burnt out as with forest fire
graceful with bunches of flowers and fruits and bowed with tender shoots
as if seed sown by a trickster in a vessel
with the cries of the (nightingale), sleepless
because of disrespect to the gods
with sweet and varied sounds of birds who made their nests
in the Krita and other ages
one who has made a dwelling
having made, he went to the sacrifice
the rising of the stories of Krishna
by service of Krishna's lotus feet
the flute song coming from Krishna's mouth
wasted away by separation from Krishna
more than water from the dust of Krishna's feet (eyes)
thinking service of Krishna's feet to be higher
from the cast skin (of a snake)
with offerings of hair-spreading, bed, bathing... (royal services)
with offerings of hair-spreading, bed and bath by hundreds of maids
hair, body hair, nails, beard and dirt
the experience of the bliss of liberation (kaivalya, nirvana)
in the hollow of a tree
of those afflicted by ignorance, desire and action
Klim (a seed syllable of a mantra)
of one afflicted by hunger and thirst
like the edge of a razor
like a snake licking its lips, Death for a mouse
for those who wish welfare here
at the foot of the lord of birds (Garuda's banner)
by the blow of a sword
despising the Ganga and the wealth of the king of kings
like the Ganga into the sea
freed from the group, poison and fire
free from the pain of weapons
in the form of a donkey
